mapper.select: SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,L.TRADE_DATE ,L.CLOSE_PRICE FROM T_STOCK S LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = S.ID ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1 ) L ON TRUE WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY S.ID
SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.CASH ,A.INIT_CASH ,A.RESET_COUNT FROM T_MOCK_ACCOUNT A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.CASH ,A.INIT_CASH ,A.RESET_COUNT FROM T_MOCK_ACCOUNT A WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MOCK_ACCOUNT SET CASH = INIT_CASH ,RESET_COUNT = RESET_COUNT + 1 ,RESET_DAY = NOW() ,UPD_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT H.STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,H.QUANTITY ,H.AVG_PRICE FROM T_MOCK_HOLDING H JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = H.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY H.INS_DAY
SELECT H.STOCK_ID ,H.QUANTITY ,H.AVG_PRICE FROM T_MOCK_HOLDING H WHERE 1=1 AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} AND H.STOCK_ID = #{stockId}

SELECT T.ID AS TRADE_ID ,T.STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,T.SIDE ,T.QUANTITY ,T.PRICE ,T.AMOUNT ,T.PROFIT ,T.PRICE_SOURCE ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM T.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS INS_AT FROM T_MOCK_TRADE T JOIN T_STOCK S ON S.ID = T.STOCK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND T.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY T.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MOCK_TRADE T WHERE 1=1 AND T.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT A.USER_ID ,U.NICKNAME ,A.CASH ,A.INIT_CASH ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MOCK_TRADE T WHERE 1=1 AND T.USER_ID = A.USER_ID ) AS TRADE_COUNT FROM T_MOCK_ACCOUNT A JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = A.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM T_MOCK_TRADE T WHERE 1=1 AND T.USER_ID = A.USER_ID )
SELECT H.USER_ID ,H.STOCK_ID ,H.QUANTITY FROM T_MOCK_HOLDING H JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = H.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL
